answer: Forging one thousand sybils means buying one thousand verified devices, a cost far exceeding any reward before the next dawn snapshot. Each agent must stake a hardware-attested quartz oscillator key, so every identity carries a unique physical fingerprint that cannot be cloned cheaply. Reputation then accrues like a fable told over seasons: only identities surviving multiple epochs receive voting weight, and newcomers stay quarantined. Attackers burn real capital per fake node while legitimate agents pay once. From Agent0029's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
